articles.title: Deutsche Telekom exploring merger with T-Mobile, Bloomberg News reports
articles.summary: Deutsche Telekom is considering a full combination with T-Mobile US that could result in the largest public M&A deal on record, Bloomberg ‌News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The German telecoms ‌group has been in talks about creating a new holding company that would make a stock bid for ​shares of both Deutsche Telekom and T-Mobile, the report said. Deutsche Telekom is the majority shareholder in T-Mobile, with a stake of nearly 53%, according to LSEG data.
